name: Kaede
source:
A third-year student and the student council president at High School A, located near Shibuya. Being as kind and warm-hearted as a saint, and beautiful too, there's no shortage of students who worship her. She has a great memory and knows the faces and names of nearly all of the students.

She seems to be unaware of her own charisma. Because of her easy, peaceful, and drama-free life, she has a fondness for gossip and crazy stories. She especially loves stories about the darker side of humanity, all the better if they're nonfiction.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
